topic: Feature — Telegram price-drop alerts on saved routes (EN, voiced)

lines.text: What if your phone told you the exact moment your flight got cheaper?
lines.visualPrompt: person looking at phone notification, surprised and happy, cozy room

lines.text: Like this. The route you saved just dropped sixty euros.
lines.visualPrompt: telegram price drop alert notification on phone

lines.text: Flight Price Watch tracks your route around the clock — every few hours, day and night.
lines.visualPrompt: real Flight Price Watch tracker page with live price chart

lines.text: You just find a route, tap the heart to save it, and connect Telegram once.
lines.visualPrompt: hand tapping save heart on a travel app, clean UI

lines.text: The second the price drops, you get an instant ping — the new price and a link to book.
lines.visualPrompt: telegram price drop alert notification on phone

lines.text: So you catch the low, instead of hearing about it after it is gone.
lines.visualPrompt: happy traveler with backpack at sunny airport, golden hour

lines.text: It is free for your first two routes. Save a route and turn on alerts — link in bio.
lines.visualPrompt: traveler walking through airport confidently, cheerful
